
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/tcjiaan/p/20499508" title="发布于 2026-06-13 22:37">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">【EF Core】继承策略——TPC</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>在开始主题之前，老周分享另一个知识，碰巧这知识点也是 EF Core 的，是前些天一位新手程序猿问的，他那是一个小项目，因为小，所以采用 Code First 的方案。不过程序有两个版本，一个是用 SQLite 数据库，一个用 SQL Server。然后有些实体他设定了 CHECK 约束。众所周知，配置 CHECK 约束是直接用 SQL 表达式的。这位同仁比较负责，他觉得哪怕用 EF Core 生成数据库也要规范一点，字段名也应该用边界字符，比如，在 SQLite 中，边界是双引号，表达式应写成 "age" &gt; 15，在 SQL Server 中写成 [age] &gt; 15。</p>
<p>同仁的意思是，他不想硬编码，EF Core 有没有相关的 API 可以根据不同数据库，自动产生边界字符。于是，作为“老一辈”，老周教了他两招。</p>
<p>1、比较笨的方法，其实也是硬编码。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--------------------------------- 实体类 ------------------------------</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Person
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Id { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> required <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Name { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Age { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">-------------------------------- 数据库上下文 ----------------------------</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TestContext:DbContext
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> TestContext(DbContextOptions&lt;TestContext&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> options)
        : </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">base</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(options)
    { }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> entity = modelBuilder.Entity&lt;Person&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置主键</span>
        entity.HasKey(b =&gt; b.Id).HasName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PK_People</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置表映射</span>
        entity.ToTable(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_people</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, tb =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 列映射</span>
            tb.Property(a =&gt; a.Id).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ps_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            tb.Property(a </span>=&gt; a.Name).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ps_name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            tb.Property(a </span>=&gt; a.Age).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ps_age</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置CHECK约束</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> delimiteLeft = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span>, delimiteRight = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(<strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">this</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">.Database.IsSqlite()</span></strong>)
            {
                delimiteLeft </span>= delimiteRight = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(<strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">this</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">.Database.IsSqlServer()</span></strong>)
            {
                delimiteLeft </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                delimiteRight </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            }
            tb.HasCheckConstraint(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">CK_Age</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">$<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{delimiteLeft}ps_age{delimiteRight} &gt; 20</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        });
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>这套方案是使用了&nbsp;IsSqlServer 方法来判断当前配置的是否为 SQL Server 数据库，IsSqlite 方法判断当前配置的是否为 SQLite 数据库。</p>
<p>实例化上下文时，通过构造函数来传递选项，以使用不同的数据库。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 用 SQL Server</span>
DbContextOptionsBuilder&lt;TestContext&gt; opbuilder1 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
opbuilder1.UseSqlServer(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Server=...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> ctx = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TestContext(opbuilder1.Options))
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 这里咱们不是真的建库，仅获取生成的 SQL</span>
    Console.WriteLine(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">使用 SQL Server 数据：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    Console.WriteLine(ctx.Database.GenerateCreateScript());
    Console.Write(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用 SQLite 数据库</span>
DbContextOptionsBuilder&lt;TestContext&gt; opbuilder2 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
opbuilder2.UseSqlite(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">data source=...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> ctx = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TestContext(opbuilder2.Options))
{
    Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">使用 SQLite 数据：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    Console.WriteLine(ctx.Database.GenerateCreateScript());
    Console.Write(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>结果如下：</p>

<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">使用 SQL Server 数据：
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CREATE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TABLE</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">tb_people</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">ps_id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">IDENTITY</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">ps_name</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">nvarchar</span>(<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">max</span>) <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CONSTRAINT</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">PK_People</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">PRIMARY</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">KEY</span> (<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">ps_id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CONSTRAINT</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">CK_Age</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CHECK</span> (<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">ps_age</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&gt;</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">20</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
);

使用 SQLite 数据：
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CREATE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TABLE</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> "tb_people" (
    "ps_id" </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">INTEGER</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CONSTRAINT</span> "PK_People" <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">PRIMARY</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">KEY</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AUTOINCREMENT,
    "ps_name" </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TEXT</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    "ps_age" </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">INTEGER</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CONSTRAINT</span> "CK_Age" <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CHECK</span> ("ps_age" <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&gt;</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">20</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
);</span></pre>
</div>
<p>但这种做法还是不够“老辣”，咱们看下一个方案。</p>
<p>2、巧用&nbsp;ISqlGenerationHelper 服务。</p>
<p>这个最好用，不用去判断数据库是什么，能够自动生成带边界字符的名称。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>entity.ToTable(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_people</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, tb =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 列映射</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    ……

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取服务</span>
    ISqlGenerationHelper sqlHelper = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.GetService&lt;ISqlGenerationHelper&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 生成带边界字符的列名</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> ageColName = sqlHelper.<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">DelimitIdentifier(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ps_age</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">)</span></strong>;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置CHECK约束</span>
    tb.HasCheckConstraint(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">CK_Age</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{ageColName} &gt; 20</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
});</span></pre>
</div>
<p>咱们增加一个 PostgreSQL 的 provider 来测试一下。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 用 SQL Server</span>
 DbContextOptionsBuilder&lt;TestContext&gt; opbuilder1 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
 opbuilder1.UseSqlServer(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Server=...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> ctx = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TestContext(opbuilder1.Options))
 {
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 这里咱们不是真的建库，仅获取生成的 SQL</span>
     Console.WriteLine(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">使用 SQL Server 数据：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
     Console.WriteLine(ctx.Database.GenerateCreateScript());
     Console.Write(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
 }

 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用 PostgreSQL 数据库</span>
 DbContextOptionsBuilder&lt;TestContext&gt; opbuilder2 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
 opbuilder2.<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">UseNpgsql(</span></strong></span><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Host=...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">)</span></strong>;
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> ctx = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TestContext(opbuilder2.Options))
 {
     Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">使用 PostgreSQL 数据：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
     Console.WriteLine(ctx.Database.GenerateCreateScript());
     Console.Write(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
 }

 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用 SQLite 数据库</span>
 DbContextOptionsBuilder&lt;TestContext&gt; opbuilder3 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
 opbuilder3.UseSqlite(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">data source=...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> ctx = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TestContext(opbuilder3.Options))
 {
     Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">使用 SQLite 数据：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
     Console.WriteLine(ctx.Database.GenerateCreateScript());
     Console.Write(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
 }</span></pre>
</div>
<p>得到结果如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">使用 SQL Server 数据：
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CREATE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TABLE</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">tb_people</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">ps_id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">IDENTITY</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">ps_name</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">nvarchar</span>(<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">max</span>) <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">ps_age</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CONSTRAINT</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">PK_People</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">PRIMARY</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">KEY</span> (<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">ps_id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CONSTRAINT</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">CK_Age</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CHECK</span> (<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">ps_age</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&gt;</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">20</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">GO</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

使用 PostgreSQL 数据：

    ps_id </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">integer</span> GENERATED <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">BY</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">DEFAULT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">IDENTITY</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

使用 SQLite 数据：

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CONSTRAINT</span> "CK_Age" <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CHECK</span> ("ps_age" <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&gt;</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">20</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</div>
<p>-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------</p>
<p>好了，正片开始。今天咱们聊实体继承中的第三种映射策略——TPC。TPC 是地球和平联合组织……我呸，是&nbsp;Table per Concrete Class 的缩写。它与 TPT 挺像，共同点是“每个类都有对应的表”，但不同点在于“具体类型”，啥意思呢？至少包含两个意思：</p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 51, 102, 1)">1、可实例化的类，抽象类就不映射了哟；</span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 51, 102, 1)">2、类中的属性（字段）成员，不管是本类中定义的还是从基类继承过来的，都会做列映射。</span></p>
<p>这么一说，TPC 的独立性更强。咱们上一次所聊的 TPT 策略，由于不映射从基类继承的成员，所以需要通过外键与基类所映射的表建立一对一关系，查询时需要表联合，带来了亿些性能上的问题。而 TPC 是包含了基类成员的，它不需要与基类的表建立相对关系，不设立外键，使用时直接单表查询即可。使查询过程变简单了。</p>
<p>TPC 策略很适合那种“开枝散叶”式继承的实体。典型场景是某个抽象作为公共基类，然后派生出同级别的 N 多个实现类。</p>
<p>比如，下面这个继承关系很是经典，高考每年必考。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 公共基类，很抽象的
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">abstract</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Animal
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 只是主键，无其他含义
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Id { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 这头野兽叫什么
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">abstract</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Name { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 这头野兽多大了
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">abstract</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Age { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Cat : Animal
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Name { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set;</span> } = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Age { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 新增成员，毛发纹理
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? Texture { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Dog : Animal
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Name { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">John</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Age { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 新增成员，喜欢的食物
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? FavFood { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>按照上述代码，基类是 Animal，其他两个是它的子类。且按照咱们对前两种映射策略的说明，映射策略、主键是必须在基类上配置的。正是如此，Id 属性只能定义在基类。也就是说，在模型配置时，Animal 类是要添加到实体模型中的，映射不映射由 EF Core 自己处理。</p>
<p>以 SQL Server 数据库为例，实现数据库上下文。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TestDbContext : DbContext
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnConfiguring(DbContextOptionsBuilder optionsBuilder)
    {
        optionsBuilder.UseSqlServer(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Server=(localdb)\\MY;Database=畜生档案馆;<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">MultipleActiveResultSets=True</span></strong></span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置一下日志，好查看SQL</span>
        optionsBuilder.LogTo((evtid, lv) =&gt; evtid == RelationalEventId.CommandExecuted, evtdata =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(evtdata <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CommandEventData cmddata)
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 改变文本颜色</span>
                Console.ForegroundColor =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ConsoleColor.Blue;
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 记录SQL</span>
                Console.WriteLine($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                    [SQL]
                    {cmddata.Command.CommandText}
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">);</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 记录完日志后，恢复颜色为默认</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                Console.ResetColor();
            }
        });
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> entAnim = modelBuilder.<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">Entity&lt;Animal&gt;</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">()</span></strong>;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 映射策略</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        entAnim.<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">UseTpcMappingStrategy()</span>;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 主键</span>
        entAnim.HasKey(x =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> x.Id);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 名称的最大字符数</span>
        entAnim.<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">Property(x =&gt; x.Name).HasMaxLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">)</span>;

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> entDog = modelBuilder.Entity&lt;Dog&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 表映射</span>
        entDog.ToTable(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_dogs</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, tb =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            tb.Property(g </span>=&gt; g.Id).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">dog_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            tb.Property(g </span>=&gt; g.Name).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">dog_name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            tb.Property(g </span>=&gt; g.Age).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">dog_age</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            tb.Property(g </span>=&gt; g.FavFood).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">fav_food</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        });

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> entCat = modelBuilder.Entity&lt;Cat&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 表映射</span>
        entCat.ToTable(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_cats</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, tb =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            tb.Property(y </span>=&gt; y.Id).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cat_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            tb.Property(y </span>=&gt; y.Name).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cat_name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            tb.Property(y </span>=&gt; y.Age).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cat_age</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            tb.Property(y </span>=&gt; y.Texture).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cat_texture</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        });
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>比较重要的几点，老周逐个说明一下。</p>
<p>1、数据库的连接字符串，要加上&nbsp;MultipleActiveResultSets=True，批量插入数据时会返回多个结果，不加这个会报错。和 TPH、TPT 一样，使用 TPC 策略也是在配置基类实体时调用&nbsp;UseTpcMappingStrategy 方法。</p>
<p>2、由于 TPC 策略下每个表是独立的，因此，每个表的名称，以及列的名称都可以自定义。注意要调用 ToTable 方法，再通过 TableBuilder 对象来配置列名，不要在 PropertyBuilder 上配置。在上一篇水文中，老周给大伙伴演示过，EF Core 在建立数据库 Model 的时候，若实体间存在继承关系，那么属性元数据是共享的。比如，Name 属性，从 Animal 到 Cat、Dog 实体都是共享元数据的。如果使用 PropertyBuilder.HasColumnName 来配置列名，那么，只有最后设置的名称生效，就无法做到每个派生类的列名称独立了。因此，一定要用 ToTable 方法，让表映射变成 Override 版本，EF Core 内部会自动保存每个覆盖的属性配置。</p>
<p>3、也正因为存在继承关系的成员是共享元数据的，所以，像 Name 属性那样要配置最大字符数为 15，也只能在 Animal 类上配置，而且所以派生类所映射的表中，各个继承的成员所对应的列，其类型和参数也必须相同的。即 cat_name 列和 dog_name 列的类型和所占空间大小是相同的，cat_age 与 dog_age 列也是如此。</p>
<p>下面咱们来测试一下。由 EF Core 负责创建数据库。然后向数据库插入四条记录。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> Task Main(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[] args)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 由运行时自动创建数据库</span>

        Animal[] chuShengs </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [

<p>在上述代码中，老周用的是异步等待版本。在 ASP.NET Core 项目中推荐这样，其他项目就随意吧。</p>
<p>咱们看看 EF Core 在创建数据库时生成的 SQL 语句。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CREATE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">DATABASE</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">畜生档案馆</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">cat_id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">DEFAULT</span> (<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NEXT</span> VALUE <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FOR</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">AnimalSequence</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">cat_name</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">nvarchar</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">15</span>) <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">cat_age</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">cat_texture</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">nvarchar</span>(<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">max</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CONSTRAINT</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">PK_tb_cats</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">PRIMARY</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">KEY</span> (<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">cat_id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CREATE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TABLE</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">tb_dogs</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">dog_id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">DEFAULT</span> (<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NEXT</span> VALUE <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FOR</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">AnimalSequence</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">dog_name</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">nvarchar</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">15</span>) <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">fav_food</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">nvarchar</span>(<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">max</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CONSTRAINT</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">PK_tb_dogs</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">PRIMARY</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">KEY</span> (<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">dog_id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
);</span></pre>
</div>
<p>TPC 的情况特殊，咱们看到，生成的SQL中包含在 SQL Server 中创建递增序列&nbsp;AnimalSequence。数据表创建了两个：tb_cats 和 tb_dogs。而它们的主键不再是 IDENTITY，而是由序列来产生下一个值。</p>
<p>为什么会这样呢？这是为了 EF Core 的实体追踪（跟踪）。从面向对象的角度看，Animal 是公共基类，那么，一个 Animal 对象的集合，它既可以包含 Cat 实例，也可以包含 Dog 实例。</p>
<p>你猜猜下面代码中，数据集合中会有几个实例？</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> ctx = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TestDbContext())
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取数据集合</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> animals = ctx.Set&lt;Animal&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span>(Animal anm <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> animals)
    {
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{anm.Name}\t{anm.Age}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>答案是：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Jack    <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
Lily    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
Mike    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
Peter   </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span></pre>
</div>
<p>现在咱们假设一下，如果主键由 IDENTITY 生成，而不是序列，那么，就会有一条 Cat 记录的 ID 是 1，一条 Dog 记录的 ID 也是1。结果是，Animal 类型的集合里，有两个实例的主键是 1。同理，如果继续插入数据，就会出现 ID 同时为 2 的 Cat 和 Dog 实例。EF Core 是通过主键的值来跟踪实体状态的，现在出现主键相同的实例，就不好搞了。所以，才要使用序列，保证所有派生类所在的表中，主键的值在【全局】层面不会重复。就像这样</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/367389/202606/367389-20260613165850749-1805542944.png" alt="image" width="262" height="110" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>你看，tb_cats 表中的主键值依次为 1、2，而 tb_dogs 表中的主键值则依次为 3、4。这样一来，在 Animal 集合中，这四条记录的 ID 值就不重复了，EF Core 就能进行跟踪了。</p>
<p>EF Core 在数据集合的查询中是遵守面向对象规则的。比如，咱们上面的集合—— Set&lt;Animal&gt;，它可以包含 Cat 和 Dog 实例，这是本着类型兼容性原则，Cat 和 Dog 都是派生类，可以赋值给声明为 Animal 的对象。如果把代码这样改呢。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取数据集合</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> animals = ctx.<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">Set&lt;Dog&gt;</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">()</span></strong>;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span>(Animal anm <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> animals)
{
    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{anm.Name}\t{anm.Age}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>现在你猜猜数据集合有几个实例？答案是：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Mike    <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
Peter   </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span></pre>
</div>
<p>这时候，Dog 集合只能兼容 Dog 类，除非有 Dog 的派生类。</p>
<p>虽然 TPC 策略中我们不需要配置类型鉴别器，但在查询时，生成的SQL语句，EF Core 也会插入鉴别标识的。比如前面查询 Animal 集合的，生成的 SQL 如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SELECT</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">t</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>.<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">cat_id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>, <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">t</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>.<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">cat_age</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>, <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">t</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>.<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">cat_name</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>, <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">t</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>.<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">cat_texture</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">fav_food</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>, <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">N<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Cat</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Discriminator</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span></span></strong>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">tb_cats</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">t</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">UNION</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">ALL</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SELECT</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">t0</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>.<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">dog_id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">cat_id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>, <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">t0</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>.<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">dog_age</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">cat_age</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>, <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">t0</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>.<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">dog_name</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">cat_name</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">cat_texture</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>, <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">t0</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>.<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">fav_food</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>, <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">N<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Dog</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Discriminator</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span></span></strong>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">tb_dogs</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">t0</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span></pre>
</div>
<p>咱们看到，EF Core 加了一个名为&nbsp;Discriminator 的字段，字段的值就是类名。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>咱们还有一个问题没解决：像 SQLite 这样不能用序列的数据库，在 TPC 映射策略下如何处理主键呢。最简单粗暴的方法，就是插入新记录时直接给它分配一个——我们手动赋值。</p>
<p>当然，咱们还有简单不粗暴的方法，那就是使用客户端生成器，即由 EF Core 来生成。就是用 ValueGenerator，这货在很多场合还是很有用的。</p>
<p>先看本示例的主角——实体类。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 抽象类，卡牌游戏
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">abstract</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CardGame
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 主键
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> CardId { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 名称
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">abstract</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Name { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 是否为主牌
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">abstract</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> IsMajor { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 扑克牌
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Poker : CardGame
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> required <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Name { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> IsMajor { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 牌上数字，新增
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Number { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 库洛牌
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ClowCard : CardGame
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> required <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Name { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 是否为四大元素牌
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> IsMajor { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>公共基类表示卡牌游戏的共同特征。然后就是扑克牌和库洛牌，其实二者还有些像的，扑克牌有四大主牌，库洛牌有四大元素牌。</p>
<p>用当天的日期 + GUID。这个我相信就算你一天要插入 10 的 99 次方条记录，应该也不会遇上有重复值的。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> MyIDValueGenerator : ValueGenerator&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Next(EntityEntry entry)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 当前日期</span>
        DateTime currdt =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DateTime.Now;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> firstPart = currdt.ToString(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">yyMMdd</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> GUID</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> secondPart = Guid.NewGuid().ToString(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">N</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 组成新值返回</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> firstPart + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">_</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> secondPart;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 此时，生成的值可不是临时值，而是要存入数据库的，所以返回 false</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> GeneratesTemporaryValues =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>ValueGenerator 是派生自&nbsp;ValueGenerator 的泛型抽象类。带类型参数的基类继承起来更舒服。我们要实现两个成员：</p>
<p>1、GeneratesTemporaryValues 属性：只读属性，表示此生成器生成的值是不是临时的。啥意思呢？就是生成的值只在 EF Core 跟踪实体过程用，不会存入数据库。比如自增长列，每次生成新值都是数据库完成的，但是，新的实体实例在保存到数据库前，是没有生成的值的，这时候，可以给它临时分配一个值。咱们这里生成的值是要存入数据库的，所以，要返回 false，表示非临时值。</p>
<p>2、Next 方法。返回生成的新值。本例中，老周用日期和 GUID 组成新值，用“_”字符连接。</p>
<p>下面，写一下 DbContext 的派生类，配置数据库模型。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TestContext : DbContext
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnConfiguring(DbContextOptionsBuilder optionsBuilder)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 日志配置</span>
        ILoggerFactory logfac = LoggerFactory.Create(logbuilder =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 添加控制台日志</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            logbuilder.AddConsole();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 过滤</span>
            logbuilder.AddFilter((cate, lv) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> cate == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Database.Command</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> &amp;&amp; lv ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> LogLevel.Information;
            });
        });
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置数据库</span>
        optionsBuilder.UseSqlite(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">data source=cards.db</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            .EnableSensitiveDataLogging(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            .UseLoggerFactory(logfac);
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        modelBuilder.Entity</span>&lt;CardGame&gt;(cgm =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 主键</span>
            cgm.HasKey(c =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> c.CardId);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 映射策略</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            cgm.UseTpcMappingStrategy();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置值生成器</span>
            cgm.Property(x =&gt; x.CardId).<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">HasValueGenerator&lt;MyIDValueGenerator&gt;</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">()</span></strong>;
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity</span>&lt;Poker&gt;(pkt =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            pkt.ToTable(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_poker</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, tb =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {
                tb.Property(w </span>=&gt; w.Name).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pk_name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                tb.Property(w </span>=&gt; w.CardId).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pk_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                tb.Property(w </span>=&gt; w.IsMajor).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pk_major</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                tb.Property(k </span>=&gt; k.Number).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pk_num</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity</span>&lt;ClowCard&gt;(cwt =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            cwt.ToTable(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_clowcard</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, tb =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {
                tb.Property(t </span>=&gt; t.CardId).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cc_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                tb.Property(t </span>=&gt; t.Name).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cc_name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                tb.Property(g </span>=&gt; g.IsMajor).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cc_major</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            });
        });
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>在配置模型时，调用&nbsp;HasValueGenerator 方法应用我们自己写的值生成器。注意，值生成器是针对列的，所以你得在属性成员上配置。</p>
<p>这一次的日志记录，老周玩了点新花样，用到了 .NET 的 Logging 功能，相信大伙伴在 ASP.NET Core 上都玩得很 6 的了。如果是控制台项目，记得引用这个 Nuget 库：Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Console。</p>
<p>这里咱们比较关心执行过的 SQL 语句，所以，在 Logging 的配置中，老周做了过滤。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 添加控制台日志</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">logbuilder.AddConsole();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 过滤</span>
logbuilder.AddFilter((cate, lv) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> cate == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><em><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); background-color: rgba(204, 255, 204, 1)">Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Database.Command</span></em><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> &amp;&amp; lv ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> LogLevel.Information;
});</span></pre>
</div>
<p>.NET Logging 是按日志类别（Category）来输出的，而不是 EF Core 内部使用的 Event ID，输出 SQL 语句的类别是&nbsp;Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Database.Command。配置之后，控制台只打印这个类别，且属于“信息”级别的日志（错误，调试等级别就不打印）。EnableSensitiveDataLogging 方法表示在打印日志显示查询参数的值，为了安全，一般我们不开启它，如果你想看到参数的具体的值，那就开启，投入生产环境后注释掉就好了。</p>
<p>运行程序。下面是创建表的 SQL 语句。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CREATE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TABLE</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> "tb_clowcard" (
          "cc_id" </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TEXT</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CONSTRAINT</span> "PK_tb_clowcard" <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">PRIMARY</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">KEY</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
          "cc_name" </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TEXT</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
          "cc_major" </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">INTEGER</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CREATE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TABLE</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> "tb_poker" (
          "pk_id" </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TEXT</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CONSTRAINT</span> "PK_tb_poker" <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">PRIMARY</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">KEY</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
          "pk_name" </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TEXT</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
          "pk_major" </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">INTEGER</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
          "pk_num" </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">INTEGER</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
);</span></pre>
</div>
<p>我们插入一些数据。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span>(TestContext ctx =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">())
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取集合</span>
    DbSet&lt;CardGame&gt; cardset = ctx.Set&lt;CardGame&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
    cardset.AddRange([
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ClowCard{ Name = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Watery</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, IsMajor = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span> },          <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 水牌</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ClowCard{ Name = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Move</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, IsMajor = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span> },             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 移牌</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ClowCard{ Name = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Firey</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, IsMajor = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span> },              <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 火牌</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Poker{ Name = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Hearts</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, IsMajor = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span>, Number = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span> },   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 红桃3</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Poker{ Name = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Clubs</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, IsMajor = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span>, Number = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> }     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 梅花A</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        ]);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 提交</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    ctx.SaveChanges();
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>产生的 INSERT SQL 语句如下：</p>

      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">VALUES</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@p0</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@p1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@p2</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@p3</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p>正是因为开启了&nbsp;EnableSensitiveDataLogging，所以在日志咱们能看到 p0、p1、p2 等查询参数的值。</p>
<p>最后，把刚刚插入的记录全查询出来，并打印到控制台。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> c = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TestContext())
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> cards = c.Set&lt;CardGame&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span>(CardGame cg <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cards)
    {
        Console.Write(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{0,-13}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, cg.GetType().Name);
        Console.Write(cg.CardId </span>+ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\t</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        Console.Write(cg.Name </span>+ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>结果为</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ClowCard     260613_2bd2b99c9f604a3b850cda8fab96c2ea    Move
ClowCard     260613_c59f0714bbbc4dcfa08d8c268f4756c9    Watery
ClowCard     260613_d1ba8b41a9bb4d3a86b10ea4da8e5d05    Firey
Poker        260613_1d8ea807b3244147ade7e66e7c32863e    Hearts
Poker        260613_5fbd80b854b14ddc9933259876d436af    Clubs</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>好了，今天咱们就水到这里了。</p>
